entities.name: Song of All
entities.description: A very lengthy song of over 1000 cantos about the wisdom, beliefs and worldview of Serra, expressed through her host of angels.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Figure whose wisdom and worldview the Song of All concerns; she imparted her wisdom to Brother Angus before dying.

entities.name: Brother Angus
entities.description: Added cantos beyond #1000, known as Brother Angus's Lament, after Serra imparted her wisdom to him.

entities.name: Brother Angus's Lament
entities.description: The cantos of the Song of All beyond #1000, added by Brother Angus.

events.summary: Brother Angus added cantos to the Song of All after Serra had imparted her wisdom to him before dying.
events.quote: They were added by Brother Angus after Serra had imparted her wisdom to him before dying.

relations.note: Added the cantos beyond #1000, known as Brother Angus's Lament.
